President Donald Trump's approval rating among white voters in Florida has fallen to the edge of negative territory, a striking reversal in a state and demographic group that helped power his return to the White House.

Data displayed by the Civiqs public opinion tracker showed that 47% of white Floridians approved of Trump's job performance as of Sept. 17, while 46% disapproved. Another 7% said they neither approved nor disapproved. [...] The numbers leave Trump with a net approval rating of just one percentage point among white residents of Florida.
